name: Spring vegetable garden with mineral soil amendments

mentions.name: Spring vegetable garden with mineral soil amendments
mentions.description: A personal gardening project that starts cold-weather vegetables indoors for spring planting and prepares garden soil, drawing on years of experimentation with various mineral amendments to grow exceptionally tasty produce the author hasn't seen matched in stores.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm starting cold weather veggies indoors for my spring garden and preparing the soil.

I've been playing with various mineral amendments for years and produce some extremely tasty produce I have yet to see matched in stores (even the organic section).
